realtime.notes: Live evidence added 2026-10-27. Vertex AI Live is the BidiGenerateContent WebSocket on the aiplatform host for the configured location, authenticated with the bound Google Cloud credential. Setup names the full publisher model resource and completes with setupComplete before content flows. Frames in realtime.frames.json are schema-built offline fixtures from those documented message names, not captured traffic

ocr.notes: Vertex document processing is served by the Google Cloud Document AI API, not the Vertex AI aiplatform host. The synchronous processors.process method is POST https://LOCATION-documentai.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/processors/PROCESSOR:process with an OAuth2 bearer token. A request carries exactly one rawDocument (base64 content plus mimeType) or gcsDocument (gs:// URI plus mimeType) and optional processOptions.individualPageSelector pages in provider page numbering. The ProcessResponse document carries the full text plus pages whose layout textAnchor textSegments index into that text. Online processing is the synchronous contract; batchProcess is outside the reviewed contract. These are offline schema-built fixtures, not live-provider qualification.
